definitions.explanation: The external appearance or outline of something.
The way something looks or is presented.

examples.japanese: {丸|まる}い{形|かたち}をしている。

notes:
{形|かたち} refers to the external shape, form, or appearance of something.

COMMON SHAPE VOCABULARY:
- {丸|まる}い{形|かたち}: round shape
- {三角|さんかく}の{形|かたち}: triangular shape
- {四角|しかく}い{形|かたち}: square shape
- {星|ほし}の{形|かたち}: star shape

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {形|かたち}をしている: to have the shape of
- {形|かたち}になる: to take shape
- {形|かたち}が{崩|くず}れる: to lose shape
- {形|かたち}だけ: just for show, in name only
- {形|かたち}に{残|のこ}す: to leave in tangible form

COMPOUNDS:
- {形式|けいしき}: form, format
- {人形|にんぎょう}: doll
- {形容詞|けいようし}: adjective

COMPARE:
- {形|かたち}: shape, form (general)
- {姿|すがた}: figure, appearance (of people)
